# Adopt French Estates-General (法兰西三级会议)
oe_gov2_dec_adopt_estates_general = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = supreme_authority_modifier }
		OR = {
			tag = FRA
			has_or_had_tag = FRA
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		NOT = { parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = supreme_authority_modifier }
		is_subject = no
		num_locations >= 3
		gold >= 100
		stability >= -10
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 180
				stability >= 5
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_gov2_dec_adopt_estates_general.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -100
			set_parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
		}
	}
}
